ios.desc:
HandsOnMoney is a private iOS companion app for GnuCash users.
Built for people who manage their finances with double-entry accounting and want full control on mobile.

Bring your GnuCash data with you — review accounts, track balances, edit transactions, and manage budgets directly on your iPhone, even while offline.

Built for serious personal accounting
	•	Import GnuCash data (SQLite or CSV)
	•	Full account hierarchy with double-entry correctness
	•	Create and edit transactions, including multi-split transactions
	•	Flexible budgeting: weekly, monthly, quarterly, or custom periods
	•	Multi-currency support by design

A dashboard that highlights what matters

The dashboard gives you an at-a-glance view of your finances:
	•	Burn chart showing how your balances change over time
	•	Transactions that may need attention or review
	•	Clear income and expense overview
	•	A quick snapshot of your current budgets

Designed to help you spot issues early and understand your financial flow without digging through reports.

Private by default
	•	Your data stays on your device
	•	No accounts required
	•	Works fully offline
	•	Export back to GnuCash or CSV at any time

HandsOnMoney is opinionated by design.
It’s not a replacement for GnuCash — it’s a focused mobile companion for people who care about accuracy, privacy, and control.

Best suited for GnuCash users or those familiar with accounting concepts.
